newsitem.title: USA: Community First sees no repeat of charges.
newsitem.headline: Community First sees no repeat of charges.

text.p: Community First Bankshares Inc said it does not expect a recurrence of the variety of fourth-quarter charges related to its acquisition of Mountain Parks Financial Corp.
"Our core business is doing very well, and we continue to believe the Mountain Banks transaction will be accretive to earnings in 1997," president Donald Mengedoth said.
"Applying Community First's credit standards to the Mountain Parks portfolio resulted in additional charges in the fourth quarter," Mengedoth said in a statement.

"We expect, however, that similar provisions will not be recurring and we expect to see improvement during 1997 in Mountain Parks' nonperforming assets. We also expect to recover a substantial amount of the recorded writedown through the disposition of certain loans or the related collateral."
For the quarter, Community First reported diluted earnings per share of $0.32 compared to $0.48 a year earlier. Excluding the Mountain Parks acquisition and one-time charges, it earned $0.57 a share.
